B

This is a special relativity problem involving the subtraction of collinear velocities. The relative speed between two objects moving with speeds u and v in a common frame is given by the relativistic velocity transformation formula: = |(u - v) / (1 - uv/c^2)|. Due to the principle of relativity, the magnitude of the relative velocity must be the same from both spaceships' perspectives. Calculating this speed gives (0.80c - 0.60c) / (1 - 0.80*0.60) = 0.20c / 0.52 ≈ 0.38c.
